In our experience, procurement teams looking to increase spend under management are already delivering savings in other business areas. * If you are struggling with stakeholder engagement, increasing spend under management requires selling the procurement value within the organization. results.title: Stakeholder Engagement as a Strategic Imperative in Procurement - Future of Sourcing Digital Publication
results.content: # Stakeholder Engagement as a Strategic Imperative in Procurement. Stakeholder engagement is not just a complementary activity within procurement, it is a core strategic function that directly influences the success of procurement initiatives and the overall performance of the organization. As procurement becomes more integrated with broader business strategies, the ability to understand, engage, and manage stakeholders is a critical success factor. Effective stakeholder engagement enables procurement professionals to align with organizational goals, build meaningful relationships, and deliver greater value beyond cost savings. These internal stakeholders are critical to the success of procurement initiatives. By fostering productive partnerships, improving communication, and integrating stakeholder input into every phase of the procurement process, organizations can drive innovation, minimize risk, and achieve sustainable success. The organizations that prioritize stakeholder engagement are the ones best positioned to align procurement with strategic goals—and to transform procurement into a true competitive advantage.

results.title: Stakeholder Engagement Strategies for Effective Procurement
results.content: # How to Create Effective Stakeholder Engagement in Procurement. How to Create Effective Stakeholder Engagement in Procurement. Stakeholder engagement remains one of the most persistent challenges in procurement and one of the most critical to get right. ## What Is Stakeholder Engagement in Procurement? Most procurement teams know stakeholder engagement is important, but few have a clear plan to make it happen. Building strong relationships takes careful planning, regular communication, and understanding each stakeholder’s role in procurement. ## Procurement Tailored by Stakeholder. By grouping stakeholders this way and focusing engagement where it matters most, procurement teams can use their time better. To build strong stakeholder relationships, procurement professionals must first understand their audience. ## Why Stakeholder Engagement Is a Procurement Success Factor. When procurement teams actively manage stakeholder relationships, they improve alignment, gain more support for sourcing strategies, boost compliance with processes, and increase spend under management. Engaged stakeholders are much more likely to work with procurement to achieve real results like cost savings, lower risks, and better efficiency.

results.content: Stakeholder Matrix and Pathways of Engagement – New report by ENTRACK to guide clean energy policy making. The **Stakeholder Matrix and Pathways of Engagement**report is a key component of the **ENTRACK** project, designed to guide inclusive and effective engagement with stakeholders in clean energy policy-making. The **Stakeholder Matrix and Pathways of Engagement’s methodology** involved mapping and analysing national, regional and local stakeholders from the quadruple helix (public and private sectors, academia, and citizens) based on their interests and influence in co-designing social energy policies. The **Stakeholder Matrix and Pathways of Engagement**report identifies six distinct pathways for stakeholder engagement, each tailored to meet the needs of different groups and support ENTRACK’s goals effectively:. The **Stakeholder Matrix and Pathways of Engagement**report emphasizes adaptive engagement to accommodate changing project needs and stakeholder dynamics. results.title: The importance of stakeholder engagement in procurement
results.content: ## Sign in to view more content. # The importance of stakeholder engagement in procurement. On a basic level, stakeholder engagement is the process in which organisations involve their employees, but also their clients and customers who could be affected by decisions that a business makes. I believe that stakeholder engagement can be used efficiently in the implementation of ideas, as holding this power can influence key players who hold decision making abilities within any given business. **Stakeholder engagement in the procurement industry**. In procurement terms, stakeholder engagement is critical at all levels. Engaging with the right internal stakeholders can ensure procurement functions gain understanding of strategic issues, cost-saving goals, value-add, compliance and organisational input moving forward. Procurement teams also have to be able to listen to the stakeholders whom they are engaging with, and then be ready to sell back ideas as a result of those conversations. **Five key principles to adhere to in stakeholder engagement**. I work under a mantra that there are five vital principles for procurement professionals wanting positive stakeholder engagement. It is critical that in procurement, individuals can identify who the key stakeholders are within the business. Essentially, the earlier you can engage with the relevant stakeholders the better the outcome. I believe it's critical that procurement teams listen to their stakeholders in order to manage their expectations. From a procurement perspective, acknowledging and then being able to act on stakeholder input is key to driving success. A procurement function that educates and works with stakeholders is able to create value for both parties, and best practice is a natural way to this type of success.
